items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 03.08.2026 (Monday). This is a company invoice, not an authority letter, so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs 'ab Rechnungsdatum' (from the invoice date). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (03.08.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 04.08.2026. Adding 14 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Monday, 17.08.2026. That day is a normal working day in NW (no weekend, no public holiday), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Due date: 17.08.2026.
